name: email_draft_tracking_inquiry_status
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Draft a reply providing current shipment tracking information for order O07
tests: the agent reads Grace Hopper's email thread th_r14_where_is_order, verifies order O07, checks shipment tracking, and drafts a reply with carrier and status
instruction:
You emailed support (subject 'Where is order O07?') asking for an update on your order O07 shipment. You are contacting support in chat asking them to draft a reply on your email thread with the tracking details.

Your details:
- Name: Grace Hopper
- Email: grace.hopper@example.com
- Postal Code: 02138
- Order ID: O07

persona.name: Grace H. Hopper
persona.initial_message: Hi! I sent an email asking where my order O07 is. Could you reply to my email thread with the tracking status?

arguments.body: Hello Grace, order O07 shipped via UPS with tracking number 1Z999AA10000000007. Current status is in transit.
arguments.subject: Re: Where is order O07

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: message rmsg_016 in thread th_r14_where_is_order
